blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Rising fuel prices and contractors’ concerns over project costs have contributed to failed bidding attempts for classroom construction projects under a P21.4-billion agreement between the Department of Education (DepEd) and the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH). This was reported by DPWH Undersecretary Lara Marisse Esquibil during the Senate finance subcommittee hearing on Friday on DepEd’s proposed 2027 budget. “I’ll just say here already, we’ve been encountering quite a few failure of biddings. They’ve been concerned with the costing of classrooms with fuel price increases,” Esquibil said. “So they were a bit market sounding, gave us some […]...
